pages: BRYANT SMART THERMOSTAT The Smart Thermostat with a Smarter Connection TSTATBBEWF-01* SIMPLE Designed for quick and easy installation – everything needed is in the box. EFFICIENT The Bryant Connected Portal can gather thermostat data and operational run time from the device to provide customers with quicker and more efficient service. COMPATIBLE Works with gas, oil, electric, heat pump and dual-fuel systems. Supports conventional (2H/2C) and heat pump (3H/2C) systems, humidifier, dehumidifier, and ventilator accessories. CONNECT WITH EASE The Bryant SmartHome app with guided setup makes a fast and easy connection to the Smart Thermostat. * Not intended for sale in Canada PERSONALIZED COMFORT Set daily comfort schedules and adjust home temperatures from anywhere using Bryant SmartHome app. SMART HOME READY Scan the Smart Home QR code on the back of the thermostat to connect with most third-party smart home systems. EXPERT INSTALLATION Installed by a Bryant contractor ensures that the thermostat is configured to optimally run the heating and cooling equipment. PATENT-PENDING DESIGN Thermostat easily snaps on and off its backplate thanks to our magnet and push POGO Pin design. VISUAL CUE AT STARTUP Confirm system startup with just a glance – heating, cooling and fan operation are signaled by an illuminated LED border around the screen. Homeowner Support: 1-800-428-4326 | Bryant.com
